To obtain the average bankruptcy rate and M&A (Mergers & Acquisitions) deals per year, you would first need to correct the syntax error in your query. Here's how you could structure it:

"To get the average bankruptcy rate and M&A deals by year, run the following SQL query:

```sql
SELECT
  YEAR(date) AS Year,
  AVG(bankruptcy_rate) AS Average_Bankruptcy_Rate,
  COUNT(M&A_deals) AS Number_Of_M_A_Deals
FROM
  YourTable
GROUP BY Year;
```

Replace 'YourTable' with the name of your database table containing bankruptcy rate and M&A deal data. This query will return the average bankruptcy rate, number of M&A deals, and the year for each year in your dataset."
